# Independent WHO oracle

Synthetic inputs and expected unrounded z-scores are generated by generate-oracle.R using the official pinned source functions (commits in src/growth/reference-data/manifest.json). Run in the recorded R container with extracted upstream sources mounted read-only at /who and this folder mounted at /out. No application code is called.

For 0-1856 days, use upstream individual LMS lookup and adjusted/unadjusted z-score functions with upstream adjust_lenhei. Do not use the public survey wrapper: it truncates at <60 months and treats standing measurements under 9 months as unknown, unlike the individual assessment measurement-position conversion required here. The LMS helper's two-decimal display rounding is disabled in the test environment to retain exact results. For older ages, the upstream 2007 indicator functions perform fractional-month LMS interpolation and restricted LMS extension. R's input CSV writer retains its full numeric precision. Test tolerance is 1e-6.
